data.questionText: Most of the time, my skin feels... Pick one

options.label: Dry: flaky & tight
options.subtext: Produces less natural oil, which can make the skin feel tight, rough, or flaky. Often needs extra hydration to maintain softness and glow.

options.label: Oily: greasy & shiny
options.subtext: Produces excess natural oil (sebum), which can make the skin look shiny or feel greasy, especially on the forehead, nose, and chin. More prone to clogged pores and breakouts.

options.label: Combination: oily T-zone
options.subtext: A mix of skin types where the T-zone (forehead, nose, and chin) is oily, while the cheeks and other areas may feel normal or dry. Needs balanced care for different areas of the face.

options.label: Sensitive
options.subtext: Skin that reacts easily to products, weather, or environmental factors. It may feel itchy, red, irritated, or prone to burning sensations, so gentle and soothing products work best.

options.label: Normal
options.subtext: Well-balanced skin that is neither too oily nor too dry. It usually feels smooth, comfortable, and healthy with minimal sensitivity or breakouts.

options.label: Acne-Prone
options.subtext: Skin that is more likely to develop breakouts, clogged pores, blackheads, or pimples. Needs lightweight, non-comedogenic products that won’t block pores or trigger irritation.

options.label: Dark spots
options.subtext: Uneven patches of darker skin that appear due to sun exposure, acne marks, or pigmentation. Often needs brightening and spot-correcting ingredients to even out skin tone.

options.label: Dullness
options.subtext: Skin that looks tired, flat, or lacking natural glow. Usually caused by dead skin buildup, dehydration, or stress, and benefits from gentle exfoliation and hydration.

options.label: Dryness
options.subtext: Skin that feels rough, tight, or flaky due to a lack of moisture. It often needs nourishing and deeply hydrating products to restore softness and comfort.

options.label: Redness
options.subtext: Skin that appears flushed, irritated, or uneven in tone. Often linked to sensitivity, inflammation, or environmental triggers and benefits from calming and soothing ingredients.

data.description: Select the type of skincare product you want recommendations for.

options.label: Cleanser
options.subtext: A skincare product used to remove dirt, oil, makeup, and impurities from the skin. It keeps pores clear and prepares your skin for the rest of your routine.

options.label: Moisturizer
options.subtext: Helps lock moisture into the skin, keeping it soft, smooth, and hydrated throughout the day.

options.label: Serum
options.subtext: A concentrated skincare product designed to target specific skin concerns like dullness, aging, or pigmentation.

options.label: Sunscreen
options.subtext: Protects the skin from harmful UV rays that cause sunburn, premature aging, and pigmentation.

options.label: Toner
options.subtext: A lightweight liquid that refreshes the skin, balances pH levels, and prepares it for better absorption of skincare products.

options.label: Eye Cream
options.subtext: Designed specifically for the delicate skin around the eyes to reduce dark circles, puffiness, and fine lines.

options.label: Lip Care
options.subtext: Products formulated to hydrate, repair, and protect dry or chapped lips.

data.description: Choose the texture or formulation you prefer for your skincare product.

options.label: Gel / Water-Based
options.subtext: A lightweight, fast-absorbing formula that feels fresh on the skin. Ideal for oily or acne-prone skin as it hydrates without clogging pores.

options.label: Cream / Rich
options.subtext: A thicker formula that provides deep hydration and nourishment. Perfect for dry or dehydrated skin.

options.label: Lightweight Lotion
options.subtext: A balanced formula that offers hydration without heaviness. Suitable for normal or combination skin.

options.label: Oil / Balm
options.subtext: A rich and nourishing formula that seals in moisture and helps repair dry or damaged skin.

options.label: No Preference
options.subtext: You are open to any formulation that works best for your skin type.

data.description: Select ingredients you prefer in your skincare products.

options.label: Vitamin C
options.subtext: Helps brighten the skin, reduce dullness, and improve uneven tone while protecting from environmental damage.

options.label: Hyaluronic Acid
options.subtext: A powerful hydrating ingredient that helps the skin retain moisture and appear plump and smooth.

options.label: Niacinamide
options.subtext: Helps control oil, reduce enlarged pores, improve skin texture, and brighten the complexion.

options.label: Retinol
options.subtext: A powerful anti-aging ingredient that improves skin texture, reduces wrinkles, and boosts collagen production.

options.label: Salicylic Acid
options.subtext: An exfoliating ingredient that unclogs pores, reduces acne, and helps prevent future breakouts.

options.label: Aloe Vera
options.subtext: A soothing natural ingredient known for calming irritated skin and providing gentle hydration.

options.label: No Preference
options.subtext: You are open to products with any ingredient that suits your skin needs.

data.description: Select your preferred price range for skincare products.

options.label: Under Rs 500
options.subtext: Affordable skincare products within a budget-friendly range.

options.label: Rs 500 - Rs 1000
options.subtext: Mid-range skincare products offering a balance between price and quality.

options.label: Rs 1000 - Rs 2000
options.subtext: Premium skincare products with advanced formulations and ingredients.

options.label: Rs 2000+
options.subtext: High-end skincare products with luxury formulations and brand value.

options.label: No Preference
options.subtext: You are open to skincare products across all price ranges.
